How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?

Seen • Just now
Great question. In most cases, orders are processed and shipped within about 1–5 business days (excluding weekends and holidays).
Once the item actually ships, a shipping confirmation email with the tracking number is automatically sent to the email used for the order. If you haven’t received tracking yet, it usually means the order is still being prepared or hasn’t been handed to the carrier yet.
Sometimes tracking can also take a little time to appear after the label is created because carriers need time to scan the package into their system.
If you’d like, you can share your order number and I can guide you on what to expect next.

Seen • Just now
If your tracking number shows no movement, it’s usually normal at first. Carriers often don’t scan packages until they reach their first sorting facility, which can take 5–7 business days after the label is created. During that time, the status may stay on “label created” or “awaiting pickup.”
What you can do:
Keep checking the tracking link for updates.
Allow a few business days for the carrier to process the first scan.
If there’s still no movement after about 7–10 business days, it may indicate a processing delay and the shipment may need further review.
If you’d like, you can also share your order number so I can guide you on what to expect next for your order.
